native_differs: native C-Gate 3.4.0.2001 ends every SAVE_TO_SOURCE to RELDN4A with E3810004 (Save-to-NVM EXECUTE), including a SAVE with no SET and one whose SET repeats the current value (which native also STOREs, e.g. 3901/A3000000); cmqttd skips unchanged ranges and sends Save-to-NVM only after a changed ncc range was verified, so this unchanged SAVE sends no STORE and no E381.
